import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    ans = 0
    run_length = 1

    for i in range(1, len(s)):
        if s[i] == s[i - 1]:
            run_length += 1
        else:
            if run_length % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            run_length = 1

    if run_length % 2 == 0:
        ans += 1

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
